_doc: Apply-finding benchmark corpus. Each entry under 'findings' is a saved audit finding plus its known target edit. The step-2 engine materializes the 'repo' map (path -> contents) into a tempdir + git init, then calls plan_tool/launcher.py:apply_finding(finding_body=..., step_id=target_step_id) against the embedded plan. Scoring is judge-free: the returned ApplyFindingResult.diff_text must contain 'expected_edit' (the landed-hunk marker) and apply_finding's diff is scoped to the plan file + the step's detail file only, so target_file/expected_edit always describe a plan or detail edit, never a source-file edit. Finding bodies follow plan_tool/launcher.py:FindingBullet shape (a severity token + body). Shape and scoring are documented in docs/BENCHMARK_DESIGN.md.
